'''Zhang Zongye''' ({{zh|s=张宗烨}}; born 29 January 1935) is a Chinese nuclear physicist. She is a research professor at the [[Institute of High Energy Physics]] and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS).<ref>{{cite news |url=https://news.qq.com/a/20171010/027762.htm |script-title=zh:八旬院士49岁学英语 突击3个月能做英文报告 |work=qq.com |date=2017-10-10 |language=zh |archive-date=2019-01-19 |access-date=2019-01-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190119121542/https://news.qq.com/a/20171010/027762.htm |url-status=live }}</ref> 

==Biography==
Zhang was born in [[Yenching University]], [[Beijing]], on January 29, 1935, to [[Zhang Dongsun]], a philosopher and social activist, and Wu Shaohong ({{zh|s=吴绍鸿|t=|links=no}}). Her eldest brother Zhang Zongbing ({{zh|s=张宗炳|t=|links=no}}) was an entomologist. Her second eldest brother [[Zhang Zongsui]] was a physicist. Her third elder brother Zhang Zongying ({{zh|s=张宗颖|t=|links=no}}) is also a physicist. Her [[Ancestral home (Chinese)|ancestral home]] is in [[Hangzhou]], [[Zhejiang]]. 

In September 1949 she attended the Beiman Girls' School (now Beijing No. 166 High School). In September 1952 she was accepted to [[Peking University]], where she majored in physics. 

After university, she was assigned to the Institute of High Energy Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences as an assistant research fellow.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://sourcedb.ihep.cas.cn/zw/zjrc/yszj/200907/t20090709_2041679.html |script-title=zh:院士专家张宗烨 |trans-title=Academician Zhang Zongye |work=ihep.cas.cn |date=2015 |language=zh |archive-date=2019-01-19 |access-date=2019-01-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190119121241/http://sourcedb.ihep.cas.cn/zw/zjrc/yszj/200907/t20090709_2041679.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> In 1984 she conducted research at the [[University of Tübingen]] in [[West Germany]]. She was elected an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS) in 1999.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://wemedia.ifeng.com/32914622/wemedia.shtml |script-title=zh:张宗烨：我的学术生涯 |trans-title=Zhang Zongye: My Academic Career |work=ifeng |date=2017-10-11 |language=zh |archive-date=2019-01-19 |access-date=2019-01-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190119121208/http://wemedia.ifeng.com/32914622/wemedia.shtml |url-status=live }}</ref>
